name: seo-citation-audit
summary: Audit approved local citation evidence for NAP, category, URL, ownership, relevance, indexability, duplicates, freshness, and correction priority.
inputs: business, locations, service areas, market, language, date, and scope
approved listing, directory, provider, and website evidence
external_reads: approved GBP/Maps, directory, citation provider, review, and manual evidence
approval_gates: external_read: ask before live directory, listing, review, or provider reads
provider_data: paid or credentialed calls require approval
vault_write: save only to resolved context
external_mutation: submissions, edits, claims, suppression, deletion, CMS, code, schema, and production are out of scope
done_when: business facts, source status, freshness, evidence, confidence, and limits are explicit
findings have action, owner, rationale, priority, and recheck
no submission, edit, claim, suppression, deletion, or outcome guarantee occurs
seo-quality-gate passes or is explicitly deferred
verification: verify unavailable providers produced no fabricated citation records
verify changed artifact and review registration when applicable
